note: Norwegian night trains, one entry per direction, keyed by Back-on-Track's own trip label so the trainsByNumber enrichment finds the row it belongs to. Every entry is a NAMED ORIENTED pair rather than a route name, and the reason is the shape of a national feed: Entur files each night train inside a whole line that also runs day services — F4 Oslo S–Bergen among Vy's thirty-odd daily workings — so the trip with the most stations, which a plain name or { from, to } entry selects, is a DAY train. A named entry scans every trip and requires it to cross midnight. from/to are the feed's own station spellings; the probe's route list is where they come from. Verified against the live feed by `probe-gtfs --verify-allowlists` (the 'Probe GTFS feed' workflow). SJ Nord (codespace sjn): F6 Dovrebanen is Back-on-Track row 70 and F7 Nordlandsbanen is row 71. Note 475/476 — a bare 475 is also European Sleeper's Brussels–Prague train, which is why the registry entry scopes enrich.agencyIds to the Norwegian operators.
